# Market and competition

> Market sizing, differentiation, competition, platforms and two-sided markets, and the economics of personalisation. Scope only; the review is not started.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Market and competition](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business-market/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository
